# Reporting a vulnerability

Please use GitHub's private reporting: **Security → Report a vulnerability**
(https://github.com/nixfred/blip/security/advisories/new). Do not open a
public issue for anything exploitable.

Blip's threat model, trusted computing base (the Mac), and the findings of
the 2026-08-31 audit are in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md). What
touches disk on each machine is in [docs/PRIVACY.md](../docs/PRIVACY.md).

Supported: the latest tagged release only.
